title: Preserve paired measurements with TGraph
summary: Represent measured x-y pairs without turning their x coordinates into implicit bin numbers.
description: Implement TGraph* build_graph(const std::vector<double>& x, const std::vector<double>& y). The two vectors have equal length. Preserve each ordered pair and its input order.
requirements: Return a TGraph containing exactly one point per input pair.
Use the supplied x values as x coordinates.
Use the supplied y values as y coordinates.
Preserve the order of the measurements.

examples.explanation: A graph stores paired coordinates; the point index is not a replacement for x.

hints: TGraph can be constructed from a point count plus x and y arrays.
std::vector::data() exposes the contiguous values expected by the constructor.
learning_goal: Choose TGraph for paired measurements and preserve the actual x-y correspondence.

curriculum.competency: Represent paired measurements with TGraph and inspect point coordinates.
curriculum.misconception: A graph can replace measured x coordinates with equally spaced point indices without changing the data.
curriculum.observable_success: The learner creates a TGraph whose point count, coordinates, and order exactly match the supplied paired measurements.
curriculum.acceptance: The graph contains the intended ordered pairs and tests validate coordinates rather than cosmetic drawing settings.

es.title: Conserva mediciones pareadas con TGraph
es.summary: Representa pares medidos x-y sin convertir sus coordenadas x en números de punto implícitos.
es.description: Implementa TGraph* build_graph(const std::vector<double>& x, const std::vector<double>& y). Los dos vectores tienen igual longitud. Conserva cada par ordenado y su orden de entrada.
requirements: Devuelve un TGraph con exactamente un punto por cada par de entrada.
Usa los valores x entregados como coordenadas x.
Usa los valores y entregados como coordenadas y.
Conserva el orden de las mediciones.

examples.explanation: Un gráfico almacena coordenadas pareadas; el índice del punto no reemplaza a x.

hints: TGraph puede construirse con el número de puntos y los arreglos x e y.
std::vector::data() expone los valores contiguos que espera el constructor.
es.learning_goal: Elegir TGraph para mediciones pareadas y conservar la correspondencia x-y real.

messages.Graph has the wrong number of points: El gráfico tiene una cantidad incorrecta de puntos
